description: Figure 14 is a three-part finite-element (Abaqus-style) composite presenting the simulated yield-strength field of an Fe-30Mn-9Al-0.8 C low-density steel body after multiaxial forging: a colour-scale legend plus two 3D contour views of the same forged specimen. (a) is the contour legend headed "SDV5 (Avg: 75%)", a 13-step rainbow colour bar whose top entry is printed +1.358e+03 (red) and bottom entry +6.994e+02 (dark blue); the caption states these values are yield strength in MPa, i.e. a scale of roughly 699 to 1358 MPa. (b) and (c) each show two cut sections of the double-lens-shaped forged part rendered in that same colour scale, with an X/Y/Z coordinate triad near the bottom. In (b) the sections are dominated by mid-scale green with darker blue bands running along their outer edges. In (c) one section contains a large yellow/orange central core that grades through green to blue at its periphery, while its companion section stays green-blue. Read against the legend, the interior of the forging holds the highest strength and the surface the lowest.
measured_quantities: SDV5 contour value (MPa, simulation field variable)

observations.observation: The contour legend is titled 'SDV5 (Avg: 75%)' with 13 discrete colour levels.
The highest value printed on the colour scale is +1.358e+03 (shown in red) and the lowest is +6.994e+02 (shown in dark blue); the caption states these are yield strength values in MPa.
The caption states that Fig. 14 shows simulation results for the yield strength map in MPa.
In panel (b) the two rendered sections are dominated by intermediate green tones with darker blue bands along their outer edges, indicating lower strength at the edges.

In panel (c) the right-hand section shows a large yellow/orange central core grading outwards through green to blue at the perimeter, i.e. the highest mapped value sits in the interior of the section.
Both 3D views carry a small X/Y/Z coordinate triad (the triads are oriented differently between (b) and (c)), and no numeric data labels appear on the contour maps.

The citing text states that the simulation shows the yield strength of the material depends on depth from the surface of the forged sample, being maximum at the centre and decreasing towards the surface.
The citing text notes a possible minor error between physical tensile-test sampling and the average depth used for reporting simulated yield strength.
The citing text states that texture effects were not considered in the simulation and that the simulated strength is therefore lower than the experimentally measured value.

subfigures.description: Contour colour legend headed 'SDV5 (Avg: 75%)' with 13 discrete levels from +1.358e+03 (red, top) down to +6.994e+02 (dark blue, bottom). The caption identifies these as yield strength values in MPa.
3D Abaqus contour view of two cut sections of the forged specimen, coloured mostly mid-green with darker blue bands along the outer edges; X/Y/Z coordinate triad at bottom, no numeric annotation.

Second 3D contour view of two sections in the same colour scale; the right section shows a large yellow/orange central region surrounded by green and then blue at the rim, indicating a maximum in the interior. Z/Y/X coordinate triad at bottom.

unreadable_items: The contour maps in (b) and (c) carry no numeric labels, so the yield-strength value at any specific location cannot be read directly (only banded by comparison with the legend).
Colour-band boundaries of the contour maps are approximate; exact isoline values are not printed on the maps.
